sloka: लक्ष्मणस्त्वङ्गदीयायां संवत्सरमथोषितः ।पुत्रे स्थिते दुराधर्षे अयोध्यां पुनरागमत् ।। ७.१०२.१३ ॥
transliteration: lakṣmaṇastvaṅgadīyāyāṁ saṁvatsaramathoṣitaḥ ।putre sthite durādharṣe ayodhyāṁ punarāgamat ।। 7.102.13 ॥

translations.english: Lakshmana, having resided for a year in Angada's territory until his unconquerable son was established, then returned to Ayodhya.
